name: Motion Principles
tagline: A blue ball bounces, stretches and leaves ghost trails while handwritten notes name every animation principle.
description: Motion-designer showreel that annotates its own craft. White and black scenes hard-cut against each other: a ball squashes and stretches over a thin floor line leaving onion-skin outlines, a giant word snaps on elastic, a position-vs-time curve draws above a square with ghosted frames showing spacing, a particle trail follows a curve, a progress ring winds up with anticipation, and a motion-blurred stagger resolves into a name card whose full stop is the ball.

display.usage: Statements and name 200–300px, tracking -0.03em, all caps; can be scaled non-uniformly to show stretch

body.usage: Handwritten annotations 64–84px in blue (red for corrections), slightly rotated, written on left to right

mono.usage: Tiny uppercase labels 22–26px, tracking 0.16em, 50% opacity: axis names, easing values, frame rate

transitions: hard cut between white and black scenes, no fades or wipes
the ball or its trail from one scene is never carried across a cut; each scene starts moving on its first frame
textAnimations: handwriting write-on: clip-path inset 100% → 0 on the right edge, linear, 0.3–0.45s
arrows: SVG path with pathLength=1000 and dasharray 1000, strokeDashoffset 1000 → 0 (GSAP rounds px values, so avoid pathLength=1), 0.15–0.3s, arrowhead drawn in the same path
giant word: scaleX 2.6 / scaleY 0.3 → 1 / 1.7 on elastic.out, 0.55s
name rises from a clipped baseline on expo.out; the full stop drops as the ball and squashes on first contact

rhythm.notes: Seven scenes of 0.7–2.2s. Every scene shows one principle moving plus one or two annotations that write on in the first half second. Last scene holds the longest.

guide:
- Palette: white #ffffff and ink #0a0a0a backgrounds that hard-cut against each other; one electric blue #2540ff (#6b82ff on black), a small red #ff3b30 only for corrections and emphasis.
- Show the principle, then name it: a blue ball (112px) on a 4px floor line, fall power2.in, rise power2.out, squash to scale 1.6×0.5 for 0.09s, stretch to 0.84×1.28 in the air, and thin blue outline circles stamped every 0.06s so the spacing shows.
- Annotations are Caveat 700 at 64–84px, rotated -4° to 3°, written on with a linear clip-path reveal and followed by a hand-drawn SVG arrow (pathLength 1000, dashoffset 1000→0, 0.2s). Use real terms: 'squash!', 'stretch', 'slow in, slow out', 'stagger: 45ms', 'follow-through'.
- Tiny mono labels (22px, uppercase, tracking 0.16em, 50% opacity) carry the data: axis names, 'ease · back.out(1.6)', 'shutter 180°'.
- Graph scene: clip-reveal the eased curve linearly while the marker's y and the square's x use the same ease, and stamp ghost squares at equal time steps so spacing is tight at the ends and wide in the middle.
- Fake motion blur by stacking 10–15 copies of an object delayed by 5ms each with falling opacity, tweened on expo.out so the copies converge into a sharp shape.
- End on a name in Inter Tight 900 around 290px where the full stop is the ball dropping with bounce.out; add one blue handwritten arrow with the call to action. Avoid gradients, glow, drop shadows, frames and decorative corner labels.
